title: Documentation, Navigator and Layout Book parity
objective: Extend the verified CAD/BIM product into a bounded professional documentation-production layer covering Navigator/project map, saved views, details, sections/elevations, associative documentation, layouts and master layouts, subsets, title blocks, schedules/index presentation, revisions and publisher sets while preserving ConstructionOS Architecture v1.1.
acceptance_criteria: Navigator/project-map records are document-owned, deterministic and persist through save/open/replay with stable canonical identities.
Representative plan, elevation, section and detail views regenerate deterministically from canonical model state with explicit source/view lineage.
Associative documentation annotations remain bound to canonical document identities and report typed dangling/source-loss outcomes rather than silently detaching.
Layouts, master layouts, subsets and title-block placement persist deterministically and produce stable serialized sheet/documentation results.
Schedules and indexes can present supported model/property data deterministically without introducing a parallel source of truth.
Revision metadata and publisher sets remain canonical, revision-aware and replay-safe.
Web and Electron share the same documentation semantic contracts and produce equivalent canonical results for representative workflows.
IFC/documentation export preserves supported semantics and reports explicit LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED outcomes outside the supported exchange contract.
Existing CAD-PARITY-002..012, COMPAT-CAD-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 fixtures remain green and byte-identical unless an explicitly reviewed migration is necessary.
Real engine behavior remains behind the existing EngineAdapterBundle/worker boundary; no renderer/application engine-internal imports are introduced.
The exact final implementation head is CI-verified, Vercel-deployed, browser/Electron verified and revision-bound before merge.
No protected architecture paths are modified.
non_goals: Unbounded document graphics or freeform page-design tooling.
New renderer architecture or engine-boundary changes.
Architecture changes without an explicit ACR.
risk_assumptions: CAD-PARITY-012 is VERIFIED and is the current component/material/coordination baseline.
COMPAT-CAD-003 provides an existing verified documentation compatibility baseline that P013 extends rather than duplicates.
COMPAT-IFC-001 is VERIFIED and remains the IFC exchange baseline.
Architecture v1.1 remains frozen throughout P013.
evidence_requirements: Deterministic view, annotation, layout, master-layout, schedule/index, revision and publisher tests.
Web/Electron parity fixtures for representative documentation workflows.
Real-OCCT/IFC coverage where documentation paths depend on model exchange, with typed unsupported outcomes where appropriate.
Regression proof that CAD-PARITY-002..012, COMPAT-CAD-003 and COMPAT-IFC-001 remain green and byte-identical.
Exact-head Vercel deployment plus real-browser/Electron evidence.
Revision-bound governance evidence covering implementation, merge and post-merge verification.

transitions.reason: Release CAD-PARITY-013 as the next bounded documentation-production slice from the authoritative CAD/BIM roadmap after CAD-PARITY-012 verification.
All declared P013 dependencies are verified on main. Assign the implementation to the logical implementation agent and require stopping at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.

Implementation begins for CAD-PARITY-013: the registration record at branch head 4c6502b references Issue #104 and program state on main (fedfe3dd) confirms CAD-PARITY-012 VERIFIED with P013 assigned. Scope is the bounded documentation-production layer per the Issue #104 acceptance contract; the implementation extends the COMPAT-CAD-003 docs baseline and the CAD-PARITY-008 layouts system additively and stops at PR_OPEN/VERIFYING for Architect review.
